forum_post: No note from the front office this week, which in my business we call a quiet rollout — and quiet rollouts are the ones that land. Kris can print whatever she wants about my kicker's one bad Sunday; the brand isn't a box score, it's a body of work, and this roster is a very good body of work. Dumbledore, baby, I see you over there being mysterious with your staircases — cute energy, but mystery doesn't show up on a stat sheet. Bring your castle. I'm bringing Kittle, Jefferson, and a brand-new Jet nobody saw coming. Can't wait for you guys to see this.
